supporting_observations.claim: Lucy Park launched Remote Desktop to DC-HD-01 at 13:32 UTC from WS-LPARK-01, and the workstation logged a connection to the domain controller on port 3389.
Lucy Park also connected to FILE-HD-01 by Remote Desktop; the server logged her interactive logon from WS-LPARK-01 at 13:36 UTC.

The observed access to DC-HD-01 is relevant to the alert: the environment context says Lucy Park is help desk and can create temporary domain accounts, and the alerted name follows the stated tmp.<name> convention. The logs do not show that she created tmp.rwong.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include a domain-controller account-creation event verifying that tmp.rwong was created during the alert window.
The supplied records do not show who created the account, its group memberships or privileges, or any subsequent logon by that account.
The supplied evidence does not establish whether relevant account-management audit events were collected for the full alert window.
claims_not_established: That tmp.rwong was actually created at approximately 13:42 UTC.
That Lucy Park created the account, or that the observed Remote Desktop activity was connected to its creation.
Whether tmp.rwong was restricted to Temp-Staff or received any unauthorized group membership or privileges.
Whether the account's creation was authorized or malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Domain-controller security or directory audit records for the alert window, including account creation, account enablement, group-membership changes, and the initiating subject and source.
The new account's creation time, creator, group memberships, privileges, and subsequent authentication events.
Any help-desk ticket or other authorization record for creating tmp.rwong.
unrelated_findings: Dropbox.exe launched under Lucy Park's account at 13:42 UTC; Dropbox is not among the approved services in the environment context. This does not establish that it was involved in the account alert. (T008-00055, T008-00056, T008-00057)

Lucy Park's workstation accessed Slack shortly before the alert; Slack is not among the approved services in the environment context. This does not establish that it was involved in the account alert. (T008-00040, T008-00041, T008-00047)
